# Charles de Lorraine, Duke of Mayenne, commander de Diou and others (BnF fr.3982 ff.97/101/124; BnF fr.3983
# ff.106/108v/211) -- see mayenne.htm. Applied by Tomokiyo (bnf4715.htm#no38, "Solution Incomplete") to BnF
# fr.4715 f.61, this folder's target. Transcribed INTAKE-4715-F61, 27 Sept 2026, from the hand-drawn table
# image mayenne.png (embedded in mayenne.htm, fetched from cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/, see
# sources/cryptiana/web/manifest_2026-09-27-4715f61.tsv), by two independent blind Sonnet subagent reads
# (each shown only the image, no context, no letter-guessing -- shapes described literally), mechanically
# compared; disagreements settled by this worker cropping and 6x-zooming the disputed columns directly
# (scratch crops, not committed). "sign" describes the hand-drawn mark's shape (glyphs cannot be typed).
# Grade AB = both blind passes agreed on this cell's shape (allowing paraphrase); grade M = this worker
# settled a disagreement from a zoomed crop; grade ? = a mark neither pass, nor this worker's own crop,
# could confidently resolve.
# Design (per both blind passes' own ink-density check, and Tomokiyo's prose): 11 columns, each pairing two
# plaintext letters (row 1 a-m, row 2 n-z stacked beneath, so column 1 = a/n, column 2 = b/o, ... column 11 =
# m/z). Only two columns (a/n, e/r) carry TWO distinct stacked hand-drawn symbols, one per letter of the
# pair; the other nine columns carry a SINGLE symbol shared by both letters of the pair -- this is the
# polyphony Tomokiyo's prose describes ("e" and "r" sharing a symbol is the one pair he names explicitly;
# this table shows a/n also drawn as two similar-but-distinct symbols, not one shared one, so the true count
# of genuinely-shared-symbol pairs may be smaller than 9 -- an open question for calibration, not resolved by
# this transcription). Three further word-code entries (que, qui, pour) sit to the right of the letter grid,
# each with one symbol. 13 letter-symbol slots + 3 word-code slots = 16 hand-drawn symbols on this table.
# Tomokiyo's own count for the TARGET LEAF's ciphertext inventory is different and larger ("only 21 kinds of
# symbols" -- bnf4715.htm#no38, his count of what actually appears written on f.61, not of this reconstructed
# key's own slot count) -- the two numbers describe different things (a general reconstructed key vs. one
# letter's attested repertoire) and are not expected to match; flagged for calibration, not an error here.
